metadata.title: DOH Maximum Drug Retail Price (MDRP) ceilings under EO 104 s. 2020 and EO 155 s. 2021
metadata.method: OCR of the signed Official Gazette annex PDFs (300 dpi), with row-by-row visual verification of every molecule, strength, and amount against the rendered page images.
metadata.price_basis: mrp_php is the published maximum retail price (consumer ceiling). mwp_php is the published maximum wholesale price and is VAT-exclusive. MRPs are VAT-inclusive except for VAT-exempt medicines; rows with vat_exclusive_mrp=true carry the order's (*) footnote.
metadata.pack_size_note: The annexes state a pack/volume only when it is part of the strength/form entry (e.g. 10 mL vial, 200 doses). For tablets and capsules the annexes do not state a pack count; pack_size is null and the ceiling is the published price for the listed unit strength/form. Do not infer a pack count.
metadata.source_note: Official Gazette PDFs are image scans. Values were transcribed by OCR and manually checked against the page images. No ceiling was inferred, estimated, or copied from EO 821 (repealed).
